reason: Reproduced in an isolated /tmp project on Linux x86-64 with uv 0.12.16, CPython 3.12.3, temporary caches, and no user configuration. The fixture used a dynamic Hatchling version, a newline-terminated VERSION file, pattern `(?P<version>[^']+)`, project dependencies `anyio==4.3.0` and `idna==3.6`, and dev dependency `iniconfig==2.0.0`. `uv lock --upgrade --python /usr/bin/python3.12 --no-python-downloads` succeeded with “Resolved 2 packages” but locked only the project and iniconfig. Hatchling 1.32.3 emitted a blank line after the Version header, placing Requires-Dist fields in the metadata body. Pinning Hatchling 1.32.0 or using a newline-excluding pattern restored all dependencies and resolved 5 packages. uv 0.12.13 also reproduced with Hatchling 1.32.3, identifying pypa/hatch#2398 as the immediate regression trigger rather than a uv 0.12.16 code change. Existing dynamic-version tests do not cover this malformed-metadata integration. The issue-context README was updated consistently.
